description:
Outcome: Teacher lends and returns books without API tools, from owner first-version journey.
Scope: Availability, pupil-label and editable due-date form, active-loan details, return control and operation-id recovery integrated with catalogue. Excludes: overdue views, filters or highlighting, pupil login.
Acceptance: Find available copy, lend, refresh and see loan, return, confirm availability, lend again. Due date editable; remove pupil label from view after confirmed return.
Behaviour: Labelled keyboard controls and announced outcomes; prevent duplicate submission while pending, preserve inputs on failures, refresh stale conflicts and recover uncertain saves by operation id.
Verification: API integration tests and manual browser/keyboard/error/refresh journey without overdue work. Prerequisites: B1 lending API, A2 catalogue UI, C1 teacher catalogue review. Assumptions: one teacher and minimal pupil label.
Setup alias: B2.
title: Teacher lending and return controls
